svg.text: Board USB-C → SBUS: cut the USB-A end off a USB-C to USB-A cable; solder VBUS, D+, D−, GND to SBUS 11, 8, 10, 12.
SBUS 4: 10 kΩ to Black Pill 3V3. SBUS 19: 300 Ω to GND. All other SBUS pins stay unconnected.
Logic inputs D0–D15 are 3.3 V CMOS with internal pull-down. Console: 3.3 V USB-UART adapter, 115200 8N1.
